data.narrative:
Smack Technologies is a Series A defense and security company founded by Andy Markoff (former MARSOC and Palantir) and Clint Alanis (20+ years Marine special ops). The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage private peers (Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI) alongside 2 public defense contractors and 8 additional private firms.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses total raised ($32M) as a proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying $64M. Peer-median triangulation across the 4 core comparables yields a median valuation of $700M; the peer set ranges from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), reflecting material heterogeneity even within same-stage cohorts.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $54M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $382M. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty about where Smack fits within its peer cohort—stage-progression suggests a floor near $64M, while peer multiples on capital raised could support substantially higher values depending on near-term traction and market positioning. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and whether founder pedigree commands a premium within this peer set.
